home.purpose: Entry page; preflight lands here, then searches navigate by URL.

search.purpose: Search results. URL params: k (query), s (sort: price-asc-rank), rh=p_36:<min cents>-<max cents> (price range; low-price/high-price redirect to it), page.
search.notes: 16 results per page plus sponsored cards. A price-ascending search is full of accessories and smaller cards - the caller's title rules do the real filtering.

product.purpose: Product page: the real price of the selected option, availability (buy button + availability line), offer type (new / used), Prime, delivery, seller. Read-only - Add to cart / Buy Now are read for presence and NEVER clicked.
product.notes: Another installed extension injects a chrome-extension:// frame here, so Chrome refuses the debugger: execute_script reads the page through chrome.scripting (MAIN world) instead (extension capability script_fallback, 2026-10-28). Trusted CDP input (wheel, clicks) does not work on this page; scrolling falls back to scrollBy.
